newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sixth homeless person dies in French cold snap.
newsitem.headline: Sixth homeless person dies in French cold snap.

text.p: The body of a homeless man, aged 56, was found near a shopping centre in the Paris suburb of Thiais on Saturday, bringing to six the death toll from a four-day cold wave that has gripped France, police said.
Weather forecasters predicted the cold spell would last into next week, holding on until at least Monday or perhaps as long as Wednesday.
Xavier Emmanuelli, a junior minister in charge of emergency humanitarian action, urged the French people to help the homeless.
